rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening without anyone noticing.

example.english: I imperceptibly ended up at my front door.
example.traditional: 我不知不覺間已經行到屋企門口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bat1 zi1 bat1 gok3 gaan1 ji5 ging1 haang4 dou3 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this when the change or action leaves no sound or visible sign.

example.jyutping: ceon1 tin1 mou4 sing1 mou4 sik1 gam3 lai4 zo2

rows.jyutping: san4 bat1 zi1 gwai2 bat1 gok3
rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately does something secretly so that nobody finds out.

example.english: They imperceptibly took the document away without anyone finding out.
example.traditional: 佢神不知鬼不覺咁拎走咗份文件，冇人發現。
example.jyutping: keoi5 san4 bat1 zi1 gwai2 bat1 gok3 gam3 ling1 zau2 zo2 fan6 man4 gin6 mou5 jan4 faat3 jin6
